incidents.name: TheNFTV2 burn() stale approval reuse
incidents.notes: TheNFTV2.burn() paid out the underlying TheDAO tokens and moved the NFT to a dead address without clearing the token approval, so the attacker could transferFrom it back out of the dead address and burn the same NFT again in a loop.

sources.ref: onchain review: TheNFTV2 0x79a7D3559D73EA032120A69E59223d4375DEb595 created 2022-01-19T06:45:15Z by 0xc43473fa66237e9af3b2d886ee1205b81b14b2c8, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (675 days). Loss ~19K per the PoC header, realised by selling the repeatedly redeemed TheDAO tokens into the Uniswap pair.
